name: Subsurface Scattering Parameter Conversion
definition: Converts artistic subsurface scattering parameters (medium color A and scattering distance d) into physical extinction (sigma_t) and scattering (sigma_s) coefficients for a homogeneous medium.
summary: Subsurface Scattering Parameter Conversion translates artistic medium color and scattering distance into physical volume rendering coefficients, decoupling scattering behavior from extinction scale.
